paragraphs: Agents of Discovery turns physical spaces such as museums, airports, campuses, libraries, stadiums and entire cities into interactive learning environments by blending AI-driven content generation with place-based augmented reality gameplay. Customers become what the company calls Mission Makers, turning their own stories, spaces and content into augmented reality experiences.

Location-based challenges are placed on site and tied to the customer's own content, or played from anywhere. A site can also deploy a fully customized AI avatar as its on-site guide. Self-guided tours are offered around the clock. Exhibits can be built for aquariums, zoos and museums. Text-to-speech and multiple language options are meant to keep the platform reachable for players with diverse abilities and backgrounds.

Airports are one named setting, where the pitch is turning downtime into interactive adventures built for travelers. Junior Ranger Missions on the platform cover subjects from palaeontology and fossils to International Migratory Bird Day. The chief academic officer works with public and private organizations across the United States, Australia and Canada on visitor experience. The company describes itself as a Harvard-incubated AI and augmented reality company.
